theme: An open day on the road in Virginia.
greeting: You're in Fredericksburg with a clear calendar, Dan — no meetings, just the road and whatever you decide to make of the day. What's actually asking for you is a short stack of holiday-travel bookings that have drifted well past their dates.

needsAttention.detail: The all-four-girls trip was meant to be decided by Sept 30 and booked by Oct 15; both dates are behind you, and inventory for six over Dec 13–Jan 2 only thins from here. In Todoist, Travel.
